description.text:
The second Radiant Energy (辉耀能量) theme pack holds two cards. One is one of four made in equal numbers: Sobble, Pikachu and Eevee with new artwork, or Celebratory Fanfare, whose art shows Pokémon celebrating together. The other is a holo basic Energy with a radiant border, here Fire, Fighting or Darkness, or a holo Trainer or Pokémon; with luck it is a special-art Hoopa V or a black and gold Pokémon. Some of its cards can't be used in the Standard format.

The packs came only in gift boxes. Five art sleeve gift boxes, Mew, Ice Rider Calyrex, Shadow Rider Calyrex, Single Strike Urshifu and Rapid Strike Urshifu, came out on 12 July 2024, each with one pack, black and gold sleeves, a coin die, damage-counter dice, a storage box and 30 five-card Brave Stars packs; the Fusion Strike Deck Building Advanced Gift Box held one too. Three Radiant Energy binder gift boxes, for the Fire, Fighting and Darkness types, followed on 2 August 2024 with a pack, a binder, a storage box and six 25-card Brave Stars packs. Its four main cards are numbered out of 4; the Energy, the full-art Trainers and Pokémon V, the black and gold VMAX cards and a gold Battle VIP Pass are numbered past it, up to 023.
